items.name: Wall Push-Up
items.description: Push-ups against a wall. The gentlest way to learn the pressing pattern and shoulder-blade control.
steps: Stand an arm's length from the wall
Lower your chest to the wall, elbows ~45° from the body
Press away keeping a straight line from head to heels
regressions: Step the feet closer to the wall

items.name: Incline Push-Up
items.description: Hands on a bench, table or stairs. Lower the incline over time as you get stronger.
exercises: Lower the incline once you reach 3 x 12

items.name: Push-Up
items.description: The foundation of all pushing. Rigid plank, elbows ~45°, chest to the floor.
steps: Slow negatives (3-5 s down) from the floor

items.name: Diamond Push-Up
items.description: Hands close under the chest. Shifts load toward triceps and inner chest.
steps: Keep elbows tucked and shoulders packed

items.name: Decline Push-Up
items.description: Feet elevated to shift load onto the shoulders. The key bridge toward handstand and planche work.
steps: Feet at hip height or higher

items.name: Pike Push-Up
items.description: Hips high, head travelling between the hands. A vertical-press pattern that builds handstand push-up strength.
steps: Head travels forward past the hands

items.name: Parallel Bar Dip
items.description: Pressing between parallel bars. Builds chest, triceps and shoulders; essential for muscle-ups and planche.
items.note: Don't bounce out of the bottom, and stop if the front of the shoulder hurts.

items.name: Archer Push-Up
items.description: Wide push-up shifting weight to one arm while the other stays straight. The bridge to one-arm push-ups.
steps: Archer push-ups with a towel-assisted straight arm

items.name: One-Arm Push-Up
items.description: Elite unilateral push demanding huge pressing strength and anti-rotation control.

items.name: Planche Lean
items.description: Straight-arm plank with the shoulders pushed forward past the hands. Entry point to planche training.
steps: Increase the lean until shoulders are well over the hands
Hold with protracted shoulders and posterior pelvic tilt
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
items.description: Push-ups with hands by the hips and a forward lean. Builds dynamic planche strength.
steps: Hands at the hips, deeper lean
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Tuck Planche
items.description: Feet off the floor, knees tucked tight to the chest, arms straight.
steps: Planche lean with one foot lifting
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Advanced Tuck Planche
items.description: Back flat and hips level with the shoulders, knees still bent.
steps: Hold with hips at shoulder height
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Straddle Planche
items.description: Legs straight and spread wide, body parallel to the floor.
steps: Advanced tuck with one leg extended
Straight legs with a flat body
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Full Planche
items.description: The iconic skill: body horizontal, legs together, supported on straight arms.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Wall Handstand Push-Up
items.description: Vertical pressing against a wall.
items.note: Use a mat, and learn how to bail safely out of a handstand before you train this.

items.name: Freestanding Handstand Push-Up
items.description: Handstand push-ups with no wall. Strength and balance combined.

items.name: Inverted Row
items.description: Horizontal pulling under a bar or rings. The base of all pulling strength.
steps: Bent-knee rows with a high bar
regressions: Bend the knees and walk the feet closer

items.name: Chin-Up
items.description: Palms facing you. The biceps help a lot, so it's the usual first vertical pull.

items.name: Pull-Up
items.description: Overhand grip, chin over the bar, no kipping. The cornerstone of nearly every advanced pulling skill.

items.name: Wide Pull-Up
items.description: Wider grip, more lat emphasis, and a smaller range of motion that's harder at the top.

items.name: Archer Pull-Up
items.description: Pull to one side while the opposite arm stays extended. Builds toward the one-arm pull-up.

items.name: One-Arm Pull-Up
items.description: One of the rarest strength skills in calisthenics.
steps: Archer pull-ups with a free hand lightly assisting
items.note: High elbow and biceps tendon stress. Don't rush.

items.name: Chest-to-Bar Pull-Up
items.description: Pulling high enough to touch your chest to the bar. A key stepping stone to the muscle-up.

items.name: Bar Muscle-Up
items.description: Pull over the bar into a dip support. Combines explosive pulling, the transition and pressing.
items.note: A rushed transition can strain shoulders and elbows. Learn it slowly.

items.name: Ring Muscle-Up
items.description: The same movement on unstable rings, with a false grip and a more demanding transition.

items.name: Skin the Cat
items.description: Rotate through the bar from hang to an inverted hang. Builds shoulder mobility for the back lever.
steps: Tuck knees to chest and rotate halfway
Rotate to a deep inverted hang
regressions: Partial rotations with feet on the floor
items.note: Go slow through the deep shoulder-extension position.

items.name: Tuck Back Lever
items.description: Facing the floor with knees tucked, hips level with the shoulders.
steps: Skin the cat with hold at inversion
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Straddle Back Lever
items.description: Legs spread and straight, body horizontal.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Full Back Lever
items.description: A straight, horizontal body with legs together, facing the floor.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Tuck Front Lever
items.description: Horizontal body facing up, knees tucked. A big step up in straight-arm pulling strength.
steps: Tuck hold with a flat back
exercises: Inverted rows with a hollow body
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Advanced Tuck Front Lever
items.description: Back flat, knees pulled in but hips extended.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Straddle Front Lever
items.description: Legs straight and spread, body horizontal.
steps: Advanced tuck with one leg extended
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Full Front Lever
items.description: Fully straight, horizontal body facing up, legs together.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: L-Sit Pull-Up
items.description: Pull-ups with legs held straight out in front. Strong pulling plus core compression.

items.name: Dead Hang
items.description: Hanging from a bar. Builds grip strength and shoulder tolerance for everything on the bar.
steps: Use a thumbless grip for variety

items.name: Parallel Bar Support
items.description: Arms locked out on parallel bars with the shoulders pushed down. The start of dips and L-sits.

items.name: Side Plank
items.description: Lateral core stability. The base for flag skills.

items.name: Active Hang
items.description: A hang with the shoulders pulled down and away from the ears. Primes the scapular strength used in levers and pull-ups.
steps: Shrug shoulders away from the ears

items.name: Ring Support Hold
items.description: Support on unstable rings. Required for ring dips and muscle-ups.

items.name: Clutch Flag
items.description: A beginner flag variation: hold a vertical pole with a 'clutch' while the legs lean out sideways.
steps: Hold a pole in a clutch grip
Hips lift and body stays horizontal
items.note: Take care of the spine and ribs. Use a stable pole and a spotter or mat.

items.name: Straddle Human Flag
items.description: Body fully horizontal with legs split, both hands gripping the pole.
items.note: Heavy shoulder, oblique and spine loading. Take it slowly.

items.name: Human Flag
items.description: Body horizontal and legs together, held off a vertical pole by the arms.
items.note: Heavy shoulder, oblique and spine loading. Take it slowly.

items.name: Plank
items.description: The foundation of trunk stiffness. Squeeze glutes, ribs down, neutral spine.

items.name: Hollow Body Hold
items.description: Lower back pressed to the floor, legs and shoulders lifted. The shape behind levers, handstands and muscle-ups.

items.name: Lying Leg Raise
items.description: Raise straight legs from the floor without arching the back.

items.name: Hanging Knee Raise
items.description: Raise the knees to the chest from a hang, curling the pelvis up.
steps: Raise the knees above the hips

items.name: Hanging Leg Raise
items.description: Straight legs to horizontal or higher while hanging.

items.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
items.description: A long-lever core exercise from the knees, then from the feet.

items.name: Tuck L-Sit
items.description: Support hold with knees tucked and lifted off the floor.

items.name: L-Sit
items.description: Legs straight out in front while supported on the hands. A foundational compression skill.

items.name: Toes to Bar
items.description: Raise straight legs until the toes touch the bar.

items.name: Dragon Flag
items.description: Lie on a bench, pivot from the shoulders and lower the whole body as one straight line. Brutal anterior-chain strength.
items.note: Keep the weight on the upper back, not the neck.

items.name: Manna
items.description: A press-out of an L-sit in which the hips rise above the hands and the legs extend horizontally. Extreme compression and wrist strength.
items.note: Very high wrist and shoulder demand.

items.name: Crow Pose
items.description: Balance on your hands with knees resting on the backs of the upper arms. A first hand-balancing skill.

items.name: Wall Handstand
items.description: Chest-to-wall handstand. Teaches the straight line and shoulder stacking.
items.note: Learn how to bail (cartwheel out), and mind your wrists.

items.name: Freestanding Handstand
items.description: Hold an unsupported handstand for at least 30 s using the finger-tip and palm-push balance reactions.

items.name: Press to Handstand
items.description: Raise from a straddle stand into a handstand with straight arms and no jump. Needs strength and compression.

items.name: One-Arm Handstand
items.description: Hold a handstand on a single arm. Extreme balance control and stability.
items.note: Fall safely and keep the wrists conditioned.

items.name: Advanced Tuck Back Lever
items.description: Tighter tuck or flatter back. Bridge toward the straddle back lever.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: One-Leg Back Lever
items.description: One leg extended, the other tucked. Excellent transitional strength.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: One-Arm Back Lever
items.description: Elite straight-arm pulling. Requires tremendous shoulder stability.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: One-Leg Front Lever
items.description: One leg extended, other tucked. Key step between straddle and full front lever.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Victorian
items.description: Hanging inverted with straight body and legs raised to vertical. Brutally difficult.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Wide-Grip Push-Up
items.description: Hands wider than shoulder width. Emphasizes chest activation.

items.name: Spartan Push-Up
items.description: Alternating wide and close grip in each rep. Great for strength-endurance.

items.name: Typewriter Push-Up
items.description: Shift laterally across a wide archer position. Builds horizontal strength and control.

items.name: Aztec Push-Up
items.description: Explosive push-up that drives hips back then over the head. Advanced power movement.

items.name: Scapular Pull-Ups
items.description: Hang and depress/retract the shoulders. Essential for shoulder health and straight-arm strength.

items.name: Typewriter Pull-Up
items.description: Move laterally while holding the contracted position. Builds unilateral strength.

items.name: Clutch Flag Advanced
items.description: Extreme side lever variation. Requires elite core and shoulder strength.
items.note: Straight-arm strength work loads the elbows, biceps tendons and wrists heavily. Warm up thoroughly and add volume slowly over weeks and months.

items.name: Hollow Body Press Hold
items.description: Press the hands into the floor while maintaining hollow body tension. Great for planche progression.

items.name: V-Up
items.description: Simultaneous torso and leg raise forming a 'V'. Excellent dynamic core strength.

items.name: Bodyweight Squat
items.description: Squat to parallel or below with the heels down and the knees tracking the toes.

items.name: Glute Bridge
items.description: Lie on your back and lift the hips by driving through the heels.

items.name: Split Squat
items.description: Stationary lunge, one leg forward. Builds single-leg strength and balance.

items.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
items.description: Rear foot elevated. A challenging single-leg squat pattern.

items.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
items.description: Kneeling, lower your body forward with the feet anchored. A brutal eccentric hamstring exercise.
steps: Full range with a push-up assist
items.note: Hamstrings may cramp; start with low volume.

items.name: Shrimp Squat
items.description: One-leg squat with the rear foot held behind. Knee-dominant and balance-intensive.
steps: Assisted shrimp with a hand support

items.name: Pistol Squat
items.description: Full-depth single-leg squat with the other leg extended forward.

items.name: Dragon Pistol Squat
items.description: Single-leg squat with the free leg threaded behind the body. Extreme mobility and strength.

items.name: Cardio Base
items.description: Build aerobic capacity with easy-paced bodyweight cardio and steady holds.
exercises: Easy rounds: 8 squats, 5 push-ups, 20 s plank

items.name: Cardio Builder
items.description: Add intensity with interval cardio and longer circuits.

items.name: Cardio Peak
items.description: High-intensity metabolic conditioning to raise work capacity.
